idea: Task observation invariances must not erase distinctions needed by the query. Preserve current-time semantics and measured position/time channels without changing images or neural weights.
inputs: Exactly the same causal CLIP crops; derived current/previous frame box geometry and source-frame offsets only. No GT, assumed FPS, extra image or network update.
immutable_controls: ORIGINAL exact raster/prompt/key; LAST wording/current-time; POSITION only geometry; TIME only offsets; STATE both. Non-CLIP/fallback exactly original.
evidence_so_far: 3 CPU metadata/control tests; actual historical input audit only. No new-variant teacher or HOTA data.
hypothesis_scope: May resolve reference-frame information discarded by crop-only CLIP. Geometry is not world motion; moving-camera or hidden-reference semantics remain possible failures.
future_test: Paired same-question/image/frozen-model five-arm physical input test before whole-policy collection. If STATE used in adaptation, adequate ordinary KD gets identical STATE answers.
